_meta.source: 21st.dev inspired — adapted for Crafter Agency AI client DNA system
_meta.description: Hero sections, navigation bars, and pricing sections. All prompts use {{CLIENT_*}} DNA variables for instant client adaptation.

templates.name: Hero — Centered Text + Product Screenshot
templates.description: Centered headline, subheadline, dual CTAs at top. Large product screenshot below the fold with layered shadow. Subtle dot-grid texture.
templates.prompt:
Build a full-viewport SaaS hero section for {{CLIENT_NAME}} ({{CLIENT_SECTOR}}).

Layout: centered heading + subheading + dual CTAs stacked vertically. Below the fold: large product UI screenshot with upward offset and box-shadow: 0 40px 120px rgba(0,0,0,0.5).

Typography: {{CLIENT_FONT}} font from Google Fonts. Headline: 'clamp(40px,6vw,80px)' bold. Gradient text on key words using {{CLIENT_COLORS}}.
Background: near-black (#0a0a0a) with dot-grid overlay: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,.06) 1px, transparent 1px) 24px 24px.

Headline: '{{CLIENT_HERO_HEADLINE}}'
Subheadline: '{{CLIENT_TAGLINE}}'
Primary CTA: '{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}' — filled button, brand color.
Secondary CTA: '{{CLIENT_CTA_SECONDARY}}' — ghost/outline.

Below CTAs: social proof strip '{{CLIENT_USP_1}} · {{CLIENT_USP_2}} · {{CLIENT_USP_3}}' in small muted text.
Scroll-triggered fade-in + rise on the screenshot via IntersectionObserver.
Tailwind CDN. 100% vanilla HTML. Zero placeholders.

templates.name: Hero — Split Layout (Text Left / Visual Right)
templates.description: 50/50 split hero: text+CTAs left, product mockup or image right. Works for any industry.
templates.prompt:
Build a split-layout hero section for {{CLIENT_NAME}}.

Grid: CSS grid 2 columns (55% / 45%) on desktop, single column stacked on mobile.
LEFT: eyebrow tag '{{CLIENT_SECTOR}}', H1 '{{CLIENT_HERO_HEADLINE}}', subtext '{{CLIENT_TAGLINE}}', CTA button '{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}' + ghost '{{CLIENT_CTA_SECONDARY}}', then avatar stack + '{{CLIENT_USP_1}}' social proof line.
RIGHT: product image or video placeholder in a rounded card (border-radius:16px) with subtle shadow and a thin glowing border using {{CLIENT_COLORS}} at 30% opacity. Card tilts slightly (transform: perspective(1000px) rotateY(-6deg)). On hover: rotateY(0deg) transition 0.6s ease.

Background: dark (#080810) with mesh gradient blob in top-right using {{CLIENT_COLORS}} at 15% opacity, filter:blur(80px).
Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Tone: {{CLIENT_TONE}}.
Full Tailwind CDN HTML. GSAP CDN for entrance animation (x:-40 opacity:0 → x:0 opacity:1, stagger 0.15s).

templates.name: Hero — Video Background Cinematic
templates.description: Full-bleed looping video background, semi-transparent overlay, centered text floats over video. Play/pause control.
templates.prompt:
Build a cinematic full-viewport video hero for {{CLIENT_NAME}} ({{CLIENT_SECTOR}}).

<video> tag: autoplay muted loop playsinline, src={{CLIENT_VIDEO_URL}}, object-fit:cover, position:absolute inset:0, z-index:0.
Overlay: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(0,0,0,0.55) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0.3) 50%, rgba(0,0,0,0.7) 100%).

Content (z-index:10, centered): small eyebrow tag, H1 '{{CLIENT_HERO_HEADLINE}}' in white, subline '{{CLIENT_TAGLINE}}', CTA pair ('{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}' filled + '{{CLIENT_CTA_SECONDARY}}' ghost).

Play/pause toggle: absolute bottom-right, icon button with backdrop-blur.
Mobile fallback: if video fails to load, use a CSS gradient using {{CLIENT_COLORS}} as background.

Typography: {{CLIENT_FONT}}, headline 72px, letter-spacing:-0.02em.
Scroll indicator: animated chevron at very bottom center, fades out on scroll.
Vanilla HTML + Tailwind CDN. {{CLIENT_TONE}} aesthetic.

templates.name: Hero — Animated Gradient Mesh (Stripe Style)
templates.description: Morphing color blob mesh background like Stripe. White text container with backdrop-blur. Premium tech aesthetic.
templates.prompt:
Build an animated gradient mesh hero for {{CLIENT_NAME}}.

Background: 3 large blobs using {{CLIENT_COLORS}} at 60% opacity, positioned: top-left, bottom-right, center-top. Each blob is a div with border-radius:50%, filter:blur(100px), CSS @keyframes animation rotating hue 0→360deg over 8–12s each with different durations so they move independently. Background base color: #05050f.

Frosted content card: centered div, backdrop-filter:blur(20px), background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04), border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08), border-radius:20px, padding:48px.
Inside: eyebrow label, H1 '{{CLIENT_HERO_HEADLINE}}' gradient text using {{CLIENT_COLORS}}, tagline '{{CLIENT_TAGLINE}}', CTA '{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}'.

Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}, 700 weight. Responsive down to 320px.
3 stat items below card: '{{CLIENT_USP_1}}', '{{CLIENT_USP_2}}', '{{CLIENT_USP_3}}' with counting animation on scroll via IntersectionObserver.
Vanilla HTML + Tailwind CDN. NO Three.js needed.

templates.name: Hero — Big Bold Typography (Oversized)
templates.description: Oversized viewport-width headline as the main visual. Minimal supporting elements. Confidence through typography.
templates.prompt:
Build a bold editorial hero for {{CLIENT_NAME}} ({{CLIENT_SECTOR}}, tone: {{CLIENT_TONE}}).

Headline: '{{CLIENT_HERO_HEADLINE}}' — font-size: clamp(64px,12vw,160px), font-weight:900, font-family:{{CLIENT_FONT}}, line-height:0.9, letter-spacing:-0.04em. Text overflows container slightly. Mix of normal and gradient ({{CLIENT_COLORS}}) words for emphasis.

Below headline: single line tagline '{{CLIENT_TAGLINE}}' in muted small text (14px, 40% opacity). Then CTA button '{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}' — minimal, pill shape.

Background: solid dark or use an extreme light-on-dark inversion based on {{CLIENT_TONE}}. One horizontal rule line for structure.

Horizontal marquee at bottom of hero: scroll across '{{CLIENT_USP_1}} — {{CLIENT_USP_2}} — {{CLIENT_USP_3}} — {{CLIENT_NAME}} —' repeating. CSS @keyframes marquee, animation-duration:20s linear infinite.

GSAP: headline words slide in from below (y:60→0, opacity:0→1, stagger:0.08s) on load.
Vanilla HTML + Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Hero — Terminal / Code Developer
templates.description: Developer-focused hero. Code snippet or terminal as the central visual. Monospace aesthetic with typing animation.
templates.prompt:
Build a developer-focused terminal hero for {{CLIENT_NAME}} ({{CLIENT_SECTOR}}).

Left column: minimal headline '{{CLIENT_HERO_HEADLINE}}', subtext '{{CLIENT_TAGLINE}}', single CTA '{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}'.
Right column: terminal window component — dark card (#0d1117), window chrome with 3 dots (red/yellow/green), terminal content with syntax-highlighted code block showing a sample API call or install command for {{CLIENT_NAME}}. Typing animation: new text characters appear every 60ms via setInterval + innerHTML.

Typography: headline uses {{CLIENT_FONT}}; code uses 'JetBrains Mono' or 'Fira Code' from Google Fonts.
Background: #0a0a0a, accent color from {{CLIENT_COLORS}} for terminal cursor blink and prompt character ($).

Add: small 'Copy' button on code block, copies to clipboard and shows 'Copied!' feedback.
{{CLIENT_USP_1}}, {{CLIENT_USP_2}}, {{CLIENT_USP_3}} as feature pills below CTA.
Vanilla HTML + Tailwind CDN. Tone: technical, {{CLIENT_TONE}}.

templates.name: Hero — Waitlist / Early Access (FOMO)
templates.description: Launch page hero with live waitlist counter, email capture form, and early adopter benefits. Create urgency.
templates.prompt:
Build a waitlist hero section for {{CLIENT_NAME}} launch.

Center layout, full viewport.
Top: 'Private Beta' badge with lock icon, background:rgba({{CLIENT_COLORS}} at 15%), rounded pill.
Headline: '{{CLIENT_HERO_HEADLINE}}' — bold, 64px+.
Subtext: '{{CLIENT_TAGLINE}}'.
Waitlist counter: large animated number (start at 2847, increment by 1 every 3-5s randomly). Label: 'people already waiting'. Count-up effect on page load via requestAnimationFrame.
Email capture form: input (placeholder: 'your@email.com') + submit button '{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}' inline on desktop, stacked on mobile. On submit: hide form, show 'You're #2851 — we'll reach out soon!' success state.

Below form: 3 early adopter benefits using {{CLIENT_USP_1}}, {{CLIENT_USP_2}}, {{CLIENT_USP_3}} with checkmark icons.
'Limited spots remaining' urgency line in muted text.

Background: {{CLIENT_COLORS}} gradient mesh animated. Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Tone: {{CLIENT_TONE}}.
Vanilla HTML + Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Hero — Mobile App Showcase (Device Mockup)
templates.description: Split hero for mobile apps. Left: headline + feature bullets + app store badges. Right: phone frame with CSS-animated screen.
templates.prompt:
Build a mobile app hero section for {{CLIENT_NAME}} ({{CLIENT_SECTOR}}).

Left column: eyebrow '{{CLIENT_SECTOR}} app', H1 '{{CLIENT_HERO_HEADLINE}}', tagline '{{CLIENT_TAGLINE}}', 3 feature bullets ({{CLIENT_USP_1}}, {{CLIENT_USP_2}}, {{CLIENT_USP_3}}) with inline emoji icons. App store badges row: App Store (black) + Google Play (black) side by side. Star rating: ★★★★★ + '4.9 · 10k+ reviews' text.

Right column: iPhone frame built in pure CSS — outer rounded rectangle (border-radius:44px), notch at top, inner screen area. Screen CSS animation: @keyframes screenScroll — three app 'screens' slide up on a 6s loop showing different UI states.
Subtle parallax on the phone: mouse mousemove → slight transform translateX/Y (max ±12px) via JS event listener.

Background: {{CLIENT_COLORS}} soft gradient (light mode if {{CLIENT_TONE}} is bright, dark if not).
Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Fully responsive.
Vanilla HTML + Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Hero — Scroll-Triggered Transform
templates.description: Hero that transforms on scroll. Bold headline fills screen initially, then shrinks as product slides up. Creates reveal anticipation.
templates.prompt:
Build a scroll-triggered transform hero for {{CLIENT_NAME}}.

Initial state (scroll=0): '{{CLIENT_HERO_HEADLINE}}' fills the entire viewport in massive text, clamp(80px,16vw,200px), centered. Nothing else visible.

GSAP ScrollTrigger pin section (300vh):
- 0%→30%: headline scale 1 → 0.4, moves to top. Opacity of headline: 1 → 0.6.
- 20%→60%: product card / screenshot slides up from y:100vh → y:0 (below the shrinking headline).
- 50%→80%: CTA buttons fade in, tagline '{{CLIENT_TAGLINE}}' fades in.
- 80%→100%: full layout settled, CTA '{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}' is clickable.

Scroll indicator: animated pulsing circle + 'scroll' text at bottom center, opacity fades to 0 after first 10% scroll.

Background: #050508. Text: white. Accent: {{CLIENT_COLORS}}.
Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}, 900 weight.
GSAP CDN + ScrollTrigger. Vanilla HTML.

templates.name: Hero — Interactive Mouse-Reactive
templates.description: Hero where background reacts to mouse position. 3D product rotates on drag or background hue shifts with cursor.
templates.prompt:
Build an interactive mouse-reactive hero for {{CLIENT_NAME}} ({{CLIENT_SECTOR}}, tone: {{CLIENT_TONE}}).

Background: 3 layered divs with different colors from {{CLIENT_COLORS}} + complementary hues. On mousemove: each layer moves at different parallax speeds (0.02, 0.04, 0.08 multiplier × cursor offset from center). Result: smooth depth illusion.

Center content: H1 '{{CLIENT_HERO_HEADLINE}}', tagline '{{CLIENT_TAGLINE}}', CTA '{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}'. Text has text-shadow that also shifts slightly with mouse (max ±4px) for floating feel.

Optional: <canvas> layer behind text with particle field (200 dots) that repulse from cursor (within 80px radius). Particles connect with lines if distance < 120px.

Background transition: CSS custom property --hue interpolates ±30deg based on cursor X position. All background elements use hsl(calc(var(--hue) + Xdeg), S%, L%).

Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}, 800 weight. Fully responsive (mouse effects disabled on touch devices).
Vanilla HTML + Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Navbar — Minimal Logo + Links + CTA
templates.description: Classic minimal navbar: logo left, links center/right, CTA far right. Becomes solid on scroll. Mobile hamburger menu.
templates.prompt: Build a production-ready navigation bar for {{CLIENT_NAME}}. Desktop layout: logo (text '{{CLIENT_NAME}}' or {{CLIENT_LOGO_URL}}) far left. Nav links center: Home, Features, Pricing, About — all with hover underline slide-in animation. CTA button '{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}' far right, filled with {{CLIENT_COLORS}} primary. Scroll behavior: initially transparent (position:fixed, top:0). After scrolling 60px: backdrop-filter:blur(12px), background:rgba(5,5,7,0.85), border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06), transition:all 0.3s ease. Mobile (< 768px): hamburger icon. Click: slide-down mobile menu with all links stacked, CTA full-width. Close on outside click. Active link indicator: tiny dot or bottom border in {{CLIENT_COLORS}}. Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}, 500 weight, font-size:14px. Vanilla HTML + Tailwind CDN. Tone: {{CLIENT_TONE}}.

templates.name: Navbar — Floating Pill (Detached)
templates.description: Pill-shaped navbar floating detached from top edge. Centered. Premium minimalist look seen on modern SaaS sites.
templates.prompt:
Build a floating pill navbar for {{CLIENT_NAME}}.

Container: position:fixed, top:16px, left:50%, transform:translateX(-50%), z-index:50. The nav itself: border-radius:100px (full pill), backdrop-filter:blur(16px), background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06), border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1), padding:10px 24px, box-shadow:0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.3).

Inside pill: logo '{{CLIENT_NAME}}' left, 4 nav links centered (smaller gap), CTA button '{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}' right — small pill button with {{CLIENT_COLORS}} fill.

On scroll past 100px: pill shrinks slightly (padding reduces, font-size 13→12px, transition 0.3s) — tighter feel.
Links: no underline, font-weight:500, color:rgba(255,255,255,0.7), hover: rgba(255,255,255,1).
Mobile: pill shows only logo + hamburger. Mobile menu opens as card below pill.
Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Vanilla HTML + Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Navbar — Mega Menu Dropdown
templates.description: Full-width mega menu with categorized sub-links, icons, and featured item. Hover to reveal. Smooth animation.
templates.prompt:
Build a mega menu navbar for {{CLIENT_NAME}} ({{CLIENT_SECTOR}}).

Top bar: logo left, nav items center (Products ▾, Solutions ▾, Resources ▾, Pricing, Company), CTA '{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}' right.

On hover 'Products': full-width dropdown panel slides down (translateY(-8px)→(0), opacity 0→1, 0.2s ease). Panel: backdrop-blur:24px, background:#09090f, border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08), border-radius:0 0 16px 16px.
Panel interior: 3 columns.
Col 1: featured card with gradient background ({{CLIENT_COLORS}}), icon, title, tagline '{{CLIENT_TAGLINE}}', 'Explore →' link.
Cols 2-3: list of sub-links with icon + title + short description (2 lines). 3 items per column.

On Solutions: 2-column grid with use-case cards.
On Resources: simple list with category labels.

Close on outside click or Escape key.
Mobile: accordion-style collapsing sections.
Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Vanilla HTML + Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Navbar — Transparent Over Hero → Solid on Scroll
templates.description: Starts fully transparent over the hero image/video. Becomes opaque frosted glass on scroll. White logo inverts if needed.
templates.prompt:
Build a scroll-adaptive transparent navbar for {{CLIENT_NAME}}.

Initial state: position:fixed, background:transparent, border:none. Logo '{{CLIENT_NAME}}' white text + white links. CTA '{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}': outline white.

JS: window.addEventListener('scroll', ...) — when scrollY > 80:
- background: rgba(8,8,16,0.9)
- backdrop-filter: blur(12px)
- border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07)
- box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.04)
- CTA changes from outline to filled {{CLIENT_COLORS}}
All transitions: 0.4s ease.

Links: font-size:14px, {{CLIENT_FONT}}, letter-spacing:0.02em. Active: underline dot in {{CLIENT_COLORS}}.
Mobile: hamburger with full-screen slide-in menu. Menu items animate in with stagger 0.1s (GSAP or CSS).

Logo fallback: if {{CLIENT_LOGO_URL}} fails, use text fallback '{{CLIENT_NAME}}'.
Vanilla HTML + Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Navbar — Command Palette (⌘K Spotlight)
templates.description: Navigation with prominent ⌘K search/command palette trigger. Full-screen overlay with fuzzy search through pages and actions.
templates.prompt:
Build a command palette navbar for {{CLIENT_NAME}}.

Navbar: minimal. Logo left, 'Search... ⌘K' pill in center (looks like an input, acts as a button), nav links right, CTA '{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}'.

On click of ⌘K button OR keyboard shortcut (Cmd/Ctrl+K): show full-screen overlay.
Overlay: position:fixed inset:0, background:rgba(0,0,0,0.8), backdrop-filter:blur(8px), z-index:9999, display:flex align-items:flex-start justify-content:center, padding-top:14vh.
Panel: background:#0e0e1a, border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1), border-radius:16px, width:min(640px,90vw), max-height:70vh.
Input: large search input at top, placeholder 'Search pages, actions...'.
Results: filterable list of mock pages (Home, Features, Pricing, Contact, {{CLIENT_USP_1}}, {{CLIENT_USP_2}}) with keyboard navigation (↑↓ arrows, Enter to select).
Close: Escape key or outside click.
Selected item highlight: {{CLIENT_COLORS}} background tint.

Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Vanilla HTML + Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Navbar — Sidebar Vertical Navigation
templates.description: Vertical sidebar navigation for app/dashboard layouts. Logo top, grouped nav items, user section bottom.
templates.prompt:
Build a vertical sidebar navigation for {{CLIENT_NAME}} dashboard/app.

Layout: fixed left sidebar, width:260px, height:100vh, background:#070710, border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06).

Top: logo section — {{CLIENT_LOGO_URL}} or '{{CLIENT_NAME}}' text + version badge. Padding 20px.

Nav sections (with group labels in uppercase 9px tracking-widest text):
- 'Main': Dashboard (icon), Analytics (icon), Projects (icon)
- 'Tools': Settings (icon), Integrations (icon), API (icon)
- 'Support': Help (icon), Docs (icon)

Active item: background:linear-gradient(90deg, rgba({{CLIENT_COLORS}} at 12%), transparent), left border 2px solid {{CLIENT_COLORS}}, text:white.
Hover: background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04).

Bottom: user profile section — avatar circle, name/email, logout icon. Border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06).

Collapsible mode: at < 900px viewport, sidebar collapses to 64px showing only icons. Tooltip on hover shows label.
Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}, 13px. Vanilla HTML + Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Navbar — Bottom Mobile Tab Bar
templates.description: iOS/Android style bottom navigation bar for mobile-first experiences. 4-5 tabs with icons and labels.
templates.prompt:
Build a mobile-first bottom tab bar navigation for {{CLIENT_NAME}} ({{CLIENT_SECTOR}}).

Desktop: standard top navbar (logo + links + CTA '{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}').

Mobile (< 640px): hide top nav. Show bottom fixed bar: position:fixed, bottom:0, left:0, right:0, height:64px, background:rgba(8,8,16,0.95), backdrop-filter:blur(16px), border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08), z-index:50.

Inside: 5 equal-width tab items. Each tab: icon (24px) + label (10px) stacked vertically, centered.
Tabs: Home, Explore, {{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}, Saved, Profile.
Active tab: icon + label in {{CLIENT_COLORS}}. Inactive: rgba(255,255,255,0.4).
Middle tab ('{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}'): larger pill button in {{CLIENT_COLORS}} filling more space — the primary action.
Tab switch: add/remove 'active' class. No page reload needed — show/hide content sections.

Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}, 10px labels. Safe area inset for iPhone notch: padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom).
Vanilla HTML + Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Navbar — Centered Logo Split
templates.description: Luxury/editorial style: logo centered, navigation links split evenly on either side. Elegant spacing.
templates.prompt: Build a centered-logo split navigation for {{CLIENT_NAME}} (tone: {{CLIENT_TONE}}). Layout: 3-column grid — left nav links | center logo | right nav links. Left: 3 links (Home, About, Work) aligned right. Center: logo '{{CLIENT_NAME}}' or , centered, with subtle separator lines extending left and right from it. Right: 3 links (Journal, Clients, Contact) aligned left. Last item is CTA '{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}'. All links: {{CLIENT_FONT}} uppercase, font-size:11px, letter-spacing:0.2em, font-weight:500, color:rgba(255,255,255,0.6). Hover: color:white, with a tiny 1px underline that slides in from left (pseudo-element scaleX 0→1). Background: transparent initially → frosted on scroll (same pattern as tpl_114). Mobile: logo top center, hamburger reveals full-screen menu overlay with large links stacked + centered + stagger animation. Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Tone: {{CLIENT_TONE}}. Vanilla HTML + Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Pricing — Classic 3-Tier Cards
templates.description: Three side-by-side pricing cards. Middle card highlighted as recommended/popular. Monthly/annual toggle optional.
templates.prompt:
Build a classic 3-tier pricing section for {{CLIENT_NAME}} ({{CLIENT_SECTOR}}).

Section: background:#050510, padding:80px 0.
Heading: 'Simple, Transparent Pricing' + tagline '{{CLIENT_TAGLINE}}', centered.

Monthly/Annual toggle: pill toggle above cards. 'Annual' shows 'Save 20%' badge. JS: toggle multiplies prices × 0.8 for annual.

3 Cards side by side (CSS grid, gap:1px, or flex gap:16px):
- Starter: €0 or low price, 5 features with ✓, ghost CTA '{{CLIENT_CTA_SECONDARY}}'
- Pro (RECOMMENDED): visually elevated (border:2px solid {{CLIENT_COLORS primary}}, box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba({{CLIENT_COLORS}} 0.25)), 'Most Popular' badge top-right. Price larger. 8 features. Filled CTA '{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}'
- Enterprise: custom pricing, 'Contact us'. All features + extras. Outline CTA.

Each feature: checkmark icon + text. Pro has all Starter features + more (visually indicated).
Card style: background:#0c0c1a, border-radius:16px, border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07).
Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. GSAP scroll reveal (from below, stagger 0.15s). Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Pricing — Monthly/Annual Toggle with Savings
templates.description: Billing toggle that updates prices in real time. 'Save X%' badge on annual. Animated price transition.
templates.prompt:
Build an interactive pricing section with billing toggle for {{CLIENT_NAME}}.

Toggle component: monthly | annual pill switch. Annual: show 'Save 20%' green badge (font-size:11px, background:rgba(16,185,129,0.15), border:1px solid rgba(16,185,129,0.3)).

Price animation: when switching, price numbers animate (old price slides up + fades, new price slides in from below — CSS animation or JS classList toggle).

Cards: use same 3-tier layout as tpl_119. Prices as JS variables — update innerText on toggle.
monthlyPrices = [0, 29, 99]. annualPrices = [0, 23, 79].
Annual price shows monthly equivalent: '€79/mo' + 'Billed €948/yr' below in muted text.

Popular plan: highlighted. CTA '{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}'.
Feature list differences clearly shown. 'Most value' annotation on annual middle plan.

Background: {{CLIENT_COLORS}} subtle gradient from bottom-left, very faint (5% opacity).
Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Tone: {{CLIENT_TONE}}. Vanilla HTML + Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Pricing — Comparison Table
templates.description: Plans as columns, features as rows. Checkmarks and dashes. Sticky header row. Best for complex feature sets.
templates.prompt:
Build a pricing comparison table for {{CLIENT_NAME}} ({{CLIENT_SECTOR}}).

Section header: 'Compare Plans' centered heading. Toggle (monthly/annual) optional.

Table structure: sticky top header row with plan names + prices. Column 1 = feature category/name. Columns 2-4 = Starter / Pro / Enterprise. Plans colored: neutral | {{CLIENT_COLORS primary}} accent | white.

Feature categories (with bold category row separator):
- Core features: 5 rows
- Advanced tools: 4 rows
- Support: 3 rows
- Integrations: 3 rows

Cell values: ✓ (green icon) | ✗ or '—' (muted) | text (e.g. '10GB', 'Unlimited', 'Priority').
Pro column: background:rgba({{CLIENT_COLORS}}, 0.04), border-left/right:1px solid rgba({{CLIENT_COLORS}}, 0.2) to visually isolate it.

Sticky first column on mobile for feature names. Horizontal scroll on small screens.
Row hover: subtle highlight. Tooltip on ambiguous features (? icon → tooltip on hover).

Bottom: CTA row with one button per column. Pro: filled '{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}'.
Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}, 13px. Vanilla HTML + Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Pricing — Usage Slider (Dynamic Price)
templates.description: Interactive usage slider that dynamically updates the displayed price. Good for API/usage-based pricing.
templates.prompt:
Build a usage-based pricing section with interactive slider for {{CLIENT_NAME}}.

Top: heading 'Pay Only for What You Use' + tagline '{{CLIENT_TAGLINE}}'.

Slider component (center stage):
- Label: 'Monthly API calls' or 'Monthly users' or 'Monthly {{CLIENT_PRODUCT}} requests'
- <input type='range'> min=0 max=100, step=1, custom styled: track uses {{CLIENT_COLORS}}, thumb is circle
- Steps: [1k, 5k, 25k, 100k, 500k, 1M, Custom]
- JS oninput: update displayed values instantly

Price display: large centered number '€--/mo', updates smoothly on slide (requestAnimationFrame + lerp for smooth number transition).
Price tiers array: [[0,1000,0],[1001,5000,19],[5001,25000,49],...]

Below slider: per-unit breakdown ('€0.002 per additional call'), included features at that tier.

Cards below: 3 preset packages (Starter / Growth / Scale) as quick-select shortcuts that set slider position.

CTA: '{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}' button. Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Background: dark. Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Pricing — Bento Grid Pricing
templates.description: Bento-style asymmetric pricing layout. Large featured plan, smaller alternatives. Modern alternative to standard cards.
templates.prompt:
Build a bento-grid pricing section for {{CLIENT_NAME}} (tone: {{CLIENT_TONE}}).

Asymmetric CSS grid layout:
- Large left card (span 2 rows): Pro plan — highlighted. Large price display, gradient background from {{CLIENT_COLORS}}, full feature list, primary CTA '{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}'.
- Top-right: Starter plan — compact card, essential features, '{{CLIENT_CTA_SECONDARY}}'
- Bottom-right: Enterprise card — 'Custom pricing', contact CTA, enterprise features list
- Below: thin 'Compare all features →' link row

Each card: border-radius:20px, border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08), padding:32px.
Large card: background:linear-gradient(135deg, {{CLIENT_COLORS first}} 0%, {{CLIENT_COLORS second}} 100%), text:white. 'Most Popular' badge.
Small cards: background:#0c0c1a.

templates.name: Pricing — Free vs Pro Split (High Contrast)

templates.prompt:

2-column layout (equal width, separated by 1px divider or gap):

FREE column: white/light background, dark text (if {{CLIENT_TONE}} is light) or dark card if dark. Title 'Free Forever'. Price '€0/month'. 5 features with ✓. CTA '{{CLIENT_CTA_SECONDARY}}' ghost. Label '{{CLIENT_USP_1}}'.

PRO column: gradient background {{CLIENT_COLORS}}, white text. Title 'Pro'. Price '€29/month' (with annual note). 10 features (all Free features + more shown with different icon). CTA '{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}' white filled. Label '{{CLIENT_USP_2}}'. 'Most teams choose Pro' annotation.

Below both columns: enterprise note '{{CLIENT_USP_3}}' with link.
